GEP Integrated Monitoring Model

Building Capacity for Evidence-Informed Policy-Making

Evidence-Based Monitoring and Evaluation

Carrying out evidence-based monitoring and evaluation in green education requires national and international monitoring studies.

From Evidence to Shared Action

Prospective Questions for Country Representatives
01Current assessments

What national monitoring assessments are currently conducted in your countries to track students’ progress in climate literacy within green education?

02Future national studies

What national-level studies can be undertaken to track students’ progress in climate literacy within the green education?

03International comparability

What collaborations are required to ensure the international comparability of national monitoring studies conducted in the field of climate literacy in green education?

04From evidence to priorities

How do you evaluate the data derived from national and international monitoring assessments; what do these empirical field findings reveal regarding the current status, transformation and strategic priorities of your education systems?
